caveats: ⚑ skill2 trigger cadence: kit says 'when performing a Full Charge attack' — modeled as chargeCounter count:1 (every full charge). Yan is RL with chargeFrames 90; the datamined cadence tuple (reloadFrames 141, ammo 6, chargeFrames 90) is a known-unreliable datamine field, so the resulting re-application rate (and therefore the 5s buff's real uptime) is UNMEASURED.

⚑ skill2 uptime: the 5s window vs the full-charge interval decides whether the ATK/crit buff is effectively permanent or duty-cycled. If the effective charge cycle exceeds 5s the buff lapses between shots; unmeasured either way.

⚑ burst damage: modeled as instant on-cast (no flight time). RL burst nukes elsewhere in the roster have measured flight delay; if popup footage shows the hit landing inside the Full Burst window, add delaySec and drop noFb.
⚑ burst crit: the 348.73% hit is modeled crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate (roster default for burst damage) and core-ineligible (kit says no 'core strike'). Unmeasured for this unit.
Burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by convention (a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens) — noFb:true here follows that rule, not a per-unit measurement.

'Forced movement toward the center of attack range' is a boss-positioning effect; the scope-lock boss has a scripted range/movement profile the engine owns, so this line has no representable primitive.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Yan (RL/Fire/Supporter/Burst I) is a pure charge-support buffer plus one burst nuke. S1 is a team-wide Charge Damage ▲21.55%/10s keyed to Full Burst entry (fullBurstEnter — the kit says 'at the beginning of Full Burst', which fires on ANY team Full Burst, not only rotations Yan bursts); chargeDamagePct is the additive charge-bucket stat, not chargeDamageMultPct (the kit line is a plain 'Charge Damage ▲ x%', not a 'damage multiplier scaled by' line). S2 is a team-wide ATK ▲2.77% + Critical Rate ▲1.33% for 5s re-applied on each of Yan's own full-charge attacks; the crit line is UNSCOPED in the kit text (no 'of normal attacks' qualifier) so it is generic critRatePct, not critRateNormalPct. Burst deals 348.73% of final ATK to enemies in range as an instant on-cast hit, FB-exempt per the burst-cast convention. The forced-movement clause is unmodeled: the sim owns boss position via a measured range script, so a kit-driven reposition has no primitive and would collide with measured ground truth.
